messages:
sophia: kicking off deploy v2.15.0 canary -> 10% during change window 08:00-09:00 UTC. starting preflight probes
miguel: grabbing p95/p99 and 5xx for /v1/embed across regions
sophia: eu-west p95 +120ms at 08:04 vs baseline, request rate steady
miguel: promql I ran: `sum(increase(http_requests_total{route=~"/v1/embed.*",env="prod",region="eu-west",status=~"5.."}[5m]))/sum(increase(http_requests_total{route=~"/v1/embed.*",env="prod",region="eu-west"}[5m]))` -> ~0.95% 5xx (soft threshold 0.6%)
deploy-bot: canary SLO check: p95 <= 220ms (ok), error_rate <= 0.6% (breach). alerting #eng-oncall
oncall-bot: NOTICE: embeds-eu-west 5xx 0.95% exceeded soft-threshold 0.6% at 08:05. Pager suppressed
tara: is this caused by a migration or config change in this release?
sophia: v2.15.0 tightened client-side parallelism, likely hitting vector-store limits
miguel: logs show upstream 429s around 08:03-08:06: `kubectl -n prod logs deploy/vector-store --since=10m | grep -Ei "429|throttle"`
leo: autoscaler shows CPU ~75%, replicas at desired, no OOMs. vector-store rate-limit counter spiked
sophia: options: (1) pause ramp and investigate, (2) pin eu-west traffic back to v2.14.x, (3) full rollback. prefer short pause + mitigation
deploy-bot: hint: `/deploy hold 5067890123` to freeze ramp; `/deploy pin region=eu-west to=2.14.9` available
tara: can we do a region pin quickly if needed? how long?
miguel: region pin via router is ~20s. rollback image already in registry as v2.14.9
sophia: executing `/deploy hold 5067890123` now :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: ramp paused at 10% canary. requesting oncall ack
leo: ack from @leo (oncall). correlating: Kinesis lag normal, DB p99 up slightly but within SLA, vector-store throttle spike aligns with canary traffic
miguel: mitigation: temporarily reduce client concurrency on canary hosts (hotfix flag), bump vector-store HPA min replicas 2->3
sophia: applied client concurrency flag to canary pool (propagating), HPA bumped :white_check_mark:
leo: after mitigation (08:11) eu-west 5xx dropped to 0.55% and p95 back to +18ms
tara: if it holds below 0.6% for two consecutive 2m windows, recommend resume and continue slow ramp to 50%
miguel: agree. follow-up: open infra ticket to tune vector-store HPA thresholds and add softer client-side backpressure
sophia: resuming ramp at 08:14 `/deploy resume 5067890123`
deploy-bot: ramp resumed -> target 25% in staged increments
oncall-bot: cleared notice for embeds-eu-west at 08:15 (no longer breaching)
sophia: final decision: no rollback. post-action items: ticket for HPA tuning, backpressure circuit in client, add a dashboard annotation and release note: "brief hold at 10% due to transient vector-store throttling; resolved after concurrency and HPA tweaks"
tara: adding to release notes and tagging infra for follow-up
miguel: will monitor 30m after full ramp and post findings
leo: keeping watch on SLO dashboards until 09:00
sophia: thanks all — closing thread unless new alerts crop up
